Newmar Corporation has decided that a defect, which relates to motor vehicle safety, exists on certain 2023-2025 Super Star motorhomes, the tire valve extensions for the rear inner wheels may get damaged by contact with the outer wheels. If this happens, the inner tire could gradually lose air pressure. This could overload the outer tire and cause it to fail. Overloading may cause the rear tire to fail, increasing the risk of a crash.

Cummins alerted Kenworth to a defect which relates to motor vehicle safety in certain model year 2025 T680/T800/T880/W900/W990/C500 chassis manufactured from 06/17/2024 through 09/12/2024 with Cummins X15 engines.

The Fuel Pump Heads installed on some of the engines in the suspect population may have been built using low fatigue strength parts, making them susceptible to fracture. If a Fuel Pump Head fractures, an external fuel leak and sudden loss of fuel pressure may occur, potentially causing the engine to stall without the ability to restart. An engine stall without the ability to restart may increase the risk of a crash.

Refer to Cummins Safety Recall (Campaign) C7083 for repair information.

***** Campaign Summary *****
Nissan has notified the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) that it is issuing a Voluntary Safety Recall Campaign on certain model year 2022-2024 Nissan Z vehicles identified in Service Comm and DBS National Service History.
On affected Z vehicles, the right-hand pedestrian detection sensor connectors were reversed in the front bumper harness. In this condition, the pop-up engine hood may not operate as designed in the event of certain pedestrian collisions, potentially increasing the risk of injury.
Your Nissan dealer will replace the front bumper harness with a countermeasure part.
***** What Dealers Should Do****
1. Verify if vehicles are affected by this Voluntary Recall using Service Comm or DBS National Service history  Open Campaign I.D. R24B6
2. Dealers must not sell, lease, trade, rent or loan any vehicles in dealer inventory subject to this recall campaign until after the vehicle has been remedied.
3. Dealers should use NTB24-047 to remedy any vehicles subject to this campaign.
4. Once remedied, dealers should submit the claim, using the claims coding provided, and release the vehicle.

VOLUNTARY SAFETY RECALL CAMPAIGN
2022-2024 Z; FRONT BUMPER FASCIA SUB-HARNESS
CAMPAIGN ID #: R24B6
APPLIED VEHICLES 2022-2024 Z (Z34)
APPLIED GRADES: Z and Z NISMO
Check Service COMM or Dealer Business Systems (DBS)
National Service History to confirm campaign eligibility.
INTRODUCTION
Nissan is conducting this voluntary safety recall campaign on certain specific model year
2022-2024 Z and Z NISMO vehicles to replace the front bumper fascia sub-harness. This
service will be performed at no charge to the customer for parts or labor.
IDENTIFICATION NUMBER
Nissan has assigned identification number R24B6 to this campaign. This number must
appear on all communication and documentation of any nature dealing with this campaign.
DEALER RESPONSIBILITY
It is the dealers responsibility to check Service COMM or Dealer Business Systems (DBS)
National Service History for the campaign status on each vehicle falling within the range of
this voluntary safety recall which for any reason enters the service department. This
includes vehicles purchased from private parties or presented by transient (tourist) owners
and vehicles in a dealers inventory. Federal law requires that new vehicles in dealer
inventory which are the subject of a safety recall must be corrected prior to sale.
Failure to do so can result in civil penalties by the National Highway Traffic Safety
Administration. While federal law applies only to new vehicles, Nissan strongly
encourages dealers to correct any used vehicles in their inventory before they are retailed.

This notice is sent to you in accordance with the National Traffic and Motor Vehicle Safety Act.
Mazda Motor Corporation has decided that a defect which relates to motor vehicle safety exists in certain 2024-2025MY CX-90 vehicles produced from December 27, 2022 through August 7, 2024, and 2025MY CX-70 vehicles produced from December 5, 2023 through July 8, 2024. If you receive this notice, your vehicle is included in this recall.

What is the problem?
On certain subject vehicles, an error may occur during vehicle startup due to improper software in the Dash Electrical Supply Unit (Dash-ESU). If this happens, multiple warning messages may be displayed on the instrument cluster, and the defroster, seat belt warning, and 360 view monitor functions, and the PHEV high-voltage battery cooling system may not operate properly, increasing the risk of a crash.

24V-816 - Engine May Stall at Idle from Software Errors
Due to improper software in the Powertrain Control Module (PCM) and Battery Energy Control Module (BECM), the engine may not restart while idling from auto engine stop (i-stop). Failure to restart the engine from idle may increase the risk of a crash.

Lucid has determined that certain 2024 - 2025 Model Year Lucid Air vehicles were manufactured with a wiring harness to the Rear Drive Unit (RDU) that was shorter than the original design length. This can lead to excess stress on the harness connector, either intermittent or complete communications loss, and reduced or complete loss of power from the RDU. On Pure RWD vehicles, if communications are disrupted while the vehicle is in motion, it could result in an unwarned loss of motive power, increasing the risk of a crash.

The subject vehicles are equipped with an Overhead Console Sunshade Switch that may not be fully recessed, increasing the risk of inadvertent sunshade activation. Nationwide less than 20 units during production may have received a drivers seat cushion frame where some bolts were improperly torqued, and over time could loosen and fall off. If a bolt falls off, the drivers seat may become unsecured and rock or wobble during use, increasing the risk or severity of an injury in the event of a crash.

The subject vehicles are equipped with an ICCU which charges the vehicles 12-volt auxiliary battery and powers low-voltage vehicle accessory equipment. The ICCU may be subject to certain electrical load conditions that can cause the internal metal-oxide semiconductor field-effect transistor (MOSFET) to fail, potentially resulting in an open ICCU fuse. An open ICCU fuse results in an inability to charge the 12-volt battery. Upon fault detection, and accompanied by a series of driver warnings, the vehicle will enter a design-intended fail-safe driving mode that allows immediate full propulsion while gradually reducing drive power over time as the vehicle battery is discharged. If the vehicle is driven until the 12-volt battery state-of-charge is fully depleted the vehicle will lose all drive power, increasing the risk of a crash. Vehicle systems such as air bags, braking, and powered steering remain operational.

Vehicle systems such as air bags, braking, and powered steering remain operational.

An open ICCU fuse results in an inability to charge the 12-volt battery. Upon fault detection, and accompanied by a series of driver warnings, the vehicle will enter a design-intended fail-safe driving mode that allows immediate full propulsion while gradually reducing drive power over time as the vehicle battery is discharged. If the vehicle is driven until the 12-volt battery state-of-charge is fully depleted the vehicle will lose all drive power, increasing the risk of a crash. Vehicle systems such as air bags, braking, and powered steering remain operational.

Nova Bus (US) Inc. has decided that a defect which relates to motor vehicle safety exists in certain Nova Bus models LFS and LFS Artic and Model Years 2022 to 2024 manufactured from November 2022 to August 2024 equipped with a Casco Coolant Sensor. 

The affected vehicles may have been manufactured with a defective coolant sensor used to detect the critical low level of coolant. A defective sensor could send a false signal to the engine that the coolant level is critically low which would lead to an engine shutdown. An unexpected engine shutdown may increase the risk of a crash. 

The service document explaining the measures to be taken to remedy the affected vehicles will be published on Nova Bus web site. However, the corrective measure is not yet finalized. We will notify you again when the remedy is ready.

The subject vehicles contain a Console Extension Wiring Assembly located near the transmission shift lever that may have been improperly routed during assembly, increasing the risk of contact with the mechanical release for the shift lever lock. If the harness interferes with the shift lever lock, the transmission can be shifted out of Park without depressing the brake pedal, potentially causing a vehicle rollaway. A vehicle rollaway can increase the risk of a crash or injury to occupants or bystanders.

Certain 2021-2022 Santa Fe, Santa Fe Hybrid, Santa Fe Plug-in Hybrid, Elantra, Elantra Hybrid, and Elantra N vehicles may have been produced with insufficient solder joints on the cameras printed circuit board (PCB), which may worsen over time increasing the risk of camera failure during operation. As such, the affected vehicles fail to comply with the requirements set forth in Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard No. 111, Rear Visibility. Obstruction of the rear-view image during operation reduces rearward visibility and increases the risk of a crash or injury to bystanders. This bulletin provides instructions to inspect and replace the rear backup camera when applicable.

Altec Industries, Inc. has decided that a defect which relates to motor vehicle safety exists in certain cylinders on AM and AN model aerial devices built from October 1995 to December 1996 and parts orders for part number 035040094 during the same period. These cylinders cannot be rebuilt. If a cylinder has been rebuilt, the end gland threads could deform during disassembly or reassembly resulting in the cylinder being unable to support the intended load. The cylinder could fail causing the lower boom to fall, increasing the risk of death or serious injury.

Pagani has decided that on certain 2024 model year Pagani Utopia vehicles there is a possibility that, due to a defect identified in the manufacturing process of the PAB (passenger airbag) panel frame, the airbag could be damaged during its deployment and affect the performance of the occupant protection system, increasing the risk of injury during a front crash event.
The remedy consists of the application of dry Kevlar strips on all the edges of the panel in order to avoid any contact of the carbon fiber frame with the airbag. The complete repair will take approximately 4 hours.
Pagani will repair the affected vehicles free of charge. 
Dedicated procedures to carry out the job and list of the VINs involved can be found in the

Nova Bus (US) Inc. has decided that a defect which relates to motor vehicle safety exists in certain Nova Bus model LFS and Model Years 2022 to 2024 manufactured from September 2022 to July 2024 equipped with QStraint wheelchair securement system. 

The affected vehicles may have been equipped with a wheelchair securement system to meet ADA requirements. The system is design to have two attachment points to secure the front of the wheelchair and two to secure the rear. The affected vehicle may have been manufactured with only one attachment at the front of the wheelchair and three at the rear. With the wheelchair attachment belt in an incorrect position, the wheelchair could move more than intended while the vehicle is in motion. A wheelchair moving more than intended can lead to injury for the passenger. 

The service document CR5674 explaining the measures to be taken to remedy the affected vehicles will be published on Nova Bus web site. The vehicles can be remedied starting from January 27th 2025. The remedy, remove and reinstall in the correct position the wheelchair attachment point, should take approximately 45 minutes to complete.

This bulletin informs dealers of the presence of a safety related issue involving the Bendix EC80 ABS ECU. The bulletin provides procedures for updating software to address the issue.

Safety Recall
Updated software and procedures are now available.

Certain Vehicle Model Year 2021-2025 Kenworth chassis configured for trailer towing require a software update for the Bendix EC80 ABS ECU.

Software update procedures for certain Battery-Electric Vehicles (BEV) and EC80 ABS ECU Part numbers are not yet available.

This bulletin will be updated when software update procedures are available for these chassis.

This notice is sent to you in accordance with the National Traffic and Motor Vehicle Safety Act.
Kenworth Truck Company has decided that a defect, which relates to motor vehicle safety, exists in certain Vehicle Model Year 2021-2025 Kenworth chassis configured for trailer towing manufactured from 05/22/2020  through 12/03/2024. 
Electronic noise and/or low signal strength on the Power Line Carrier (PLC) signal from a trailer to the Bendix EC80 ABS ECU could cause the ABS system to incorrectly process certain signals. This can lead to the Bendix EC80 ABS ECU setting faults, malfunctioning, or not operating. ABS faults could affect the operation of other ABS-connected systems such as Automatic Traction Control, Electronic Stability Control, Active Cruise Control, and/or Collision Mitigation System.
These faults could cause the ABS system to respond incorrectly to a stability or automated braking event, increasing the risk of a crash. The ABS warning lamp will be illuminated in the event of faults in the ABS system or when the ABS system stops operating.
Kenworth has initiated a recall in cooperation with Bendix to remedy the defect. Please contact your Kenworth dealer. You can find your nearest Kenworth dealer using the Dealer Locator on our website www.Kenworth.com or by scanning the QR code on this letter.
This repair may take up to 1 hour of labor depending on dealer scheduling. This repair will be performed at no charge to you.

This can lead to the Bendix EC80 ABS ECU setting faults, malfunctioning, or not operating. ABS faults could affect the operation of other ABS-connected systems such as Automatic Traction Control, Electronic Stability Control, Active Cruise Control, and/or Collision Mitigation System.
These faults could cause the ABS system to respond incorrectly to a stability or automated braking event, increasing the risk of a crash. The ABS warning lamp will be illuminated in the event of faults in the ABS system or when the ABS system stops operating.
Kenworth has initiated a recall in cooperation with Bendix to remedy the defect. Please contact your Kenworth dealer. You can find your nearest Kenworth dealer using the Dealer Locator on our website www.Kenworth.com or by scanning the QR code on this letter.
This repair may take up to 1 hour of labor depending on dealer scheduling. This repair will be performed at no charge to you.

Kenworth Truck Company has decided that a defect, which relates to motor vehicle safety, exists in certain Vehicle Model Year 2021-2025 Kenworth chassis configured for trailer towing manufactured from 05/22/2020  through 12/03/2024. 
Electronic noise and/or low signal strength on the Power Line Carrier (PLC) signal from a trailer to the Bendix EC80 ABS ECU could cause the ABS system to incorrectly process certain signals. This can lead to the Bendix EC80 ABS ECU setting faults, malfunctioning, or not operating. ABS faults could affect the operation of other ABS-connected systems such as Automatic Traction Control, Electronic Stability Control, Active Cruise Control, and/or Collision Mitigation System.
These faults could cause the ABS system to respond incorrectly to a stability or automated braking event, increasing the risk of a crash. The ABS warning lamp will be illuminated in the event of faults in the ABS system or when the ABS system stops operating.
Kenworth has initiated a recall in cooperation with Bendix to remedy the defect. Please contact your Kenworth dealer. You can find your nearest Kenworth dealer using the Dealer Locator on our website www.Kenworth.com or by scanning the QR code on this letter.

This is a representative sample of a letter to inform owners of a safety campaign on certain Cummins Power Generation C275D2RE trailer-mounted generator sets. Exposed leads providing service access to fuse holders within the wiring harness of the subject generator sets may vibrate and chafe against the housing or terminal stud of the starter motor, abrading the wire insulation. This condition may result in an electrical short. An electrical short in the generator set wiring harness creates a risk of electric shock and/or fire which in turn presents a risk of burns or smoke inhalation.

Owner Notification Letter - The fuel filler neck and fuel tank may have an incomplete weld that can separate, potentially resulting in a fuel leak while the vehicle is driven or parked.

A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.

Your vehicle may be releasing air pollutants which exceed California and federal standards. If you do not have the repair done, your vehicle may fail a state or local emissions inspection required under state law.

Campaign Summary: 

Nissan will notify the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) that it is issuing a Voluntary Non-Compliance Recall on certain model year 2025 Nissan Kicks vehicles identified in Service Comm and DBS National Service History.

On certain vehicles, the Shift-to-Park warning may not be active. If the driver turns the vehicles ignition OFF while the gear selector is in a position other than Park and opens the driver side door, the Shift-to-Park warning does not display on the instrument panel and the audible alarm does not sound. This condition is not compliant with FMVSS 114; Theft Protection and Rollaway Prevention., and could potentially lead to a vehicle rollaway scenario, which may increase the risk of injury to the driver and passengers..

Dealers will re-configure the vehicles Body Control Module (BCM) via CONSULT IV to activate the Shift-to-Park warning.

***** Campaign Summary *****
Nissan will notify the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) that it is issuing a Voluntary Non-Compliance Recall on certain model year 2025 Nissan Kicks vehicles identified in Service Comm and DBS National Service History.
On certain vehicles, the Shift-to-Park warning may not be active. If the driver turns the vehicles ignition OFF while the gear selector is in a position other than Park and opens the driver side door, the Shift-to-Park warning does not display on the instrument panel and the audible alarm does not sound. This condition is not compliant with FMVSS 114; Theft Protection and Rollaway Prevention., and could potentially lead to a vehicle rollaway scenario, which may increase the risk of injury to the driver and passengers.
Dealers will re-configure the vehicles Body Control Module (BCM) via CONSULT IV to activate the Shift-to-Park warning.

VOLUNTARY SAFETY RECALL CAMPAIGN
2025 KICKS; BCM CONFIGURATION
CAMPAIGN ID #: PMA42
APPLIED VEHICLES: 2025 Kicks (P16)
Check Service COMM or Dealer Business Systems (DBS)
National Service History to confirm campaign eligibility.
INTRODUCTION
Nissan is conducting this voluntary safety recall campaign on certain specific model year
2025 Kicks vehicles to inspect and, if necessary, reconfigure the BCM. This service will be
performed at no charge to the customer for parts or labor.
IDENTIFICATION NUMBER
Nissan has assigned identification number PMA42 to this campaign. This number must
appear on all communication and documentation of any nature dealing with this campaign.
DEALER RESPONSIBILITY
It is the dealers responsibility to check Service COMM or Dealer Business Systems (DBS)
National Service History for the campaign status on each vehicle falling within the range of
this voluntary safety recall which for any reason enters the service department. This
includes vehicles purchased from private parties or presented by transient (tourist) owners
and vehicles in a dealers inventory. Federal law requires that new vehicles in dealer
inventory which are the subject of a safety recall must be corrected prior to sale.
Failure to do so can result in civil penalties by the National Highway Traffic Safety
Administration. While federal law applies only to new vehicles, Nissan strongly
encourages dealers to correct any used vehicles in their inventory before they are retailed.
